title: Concept: Version forced by a resolution strategy
description: build.gradle declares a forced version that overrides every declared constraint, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a forced version that overrides every declared constraint.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
